evals.name: broken-state-diagram-regression
evals.prompt: Review the mermaid diagram in evals/inputs/01-broken-state-diagram.md and improve it to spec-ready quality. The block contains a state-lifecycle flowchart with known visual issues.
evals.expected_output: Final mermaid source has title frontmatter, text clipping fixed, subgraph-direction issue resolved (likely via card-with-hr-pattern), cycle order fixed (linearised to terminal reset node). Iteration count <= 3.

assertions.description: A PNG was rendered at least once during the run
The final mermaid source re-renders with mmdc exit code 0
First self-review verdict's critical list mentions text clipping

evals.name: already-clean-flowchart
evals.prompt: Review the mermaid diagram in evals/inputs/02-clean-flowchart.md and improve it if needed.
evals.expected_output: Skill renders, self-review finds no CRITICAL issues, subagent confirms ship-ready, iteration count = 1, no changes applied to source (or only whitespace-equivalent changes).

assertions.description: Final source semantically identical to input (ignore whitespace)

evals.name: sequence-diagram-with-overlap
evals.prompt: Review the mermaid diagram in evals/inputs/03-sequence-with-overlap.mmd and improve it. It is a sequence diagram with long self-loops.
evals.expected_output: Skill handles the .mmd input shape, loads references/diagram-types/sequence.md, catches the self-loop collision, fixes it (likely via sequence-self-loop-note). Final source has a title frontmatter inferred from the filename.

assertions.description: Transcript shows references/diagram-types/sequence.md was read AND the file contains non-trivial sequence-specific guidance

evals.name: missing-title
evals.prompt: Review the mermaid diagram in evals/inputs/04-missing-title.md and improve it.
evals.expected_output: Pre-flight rule inserts title frontmatter before iteration loop. Final source has title 'Some Note' or 'Untitled flowchart diagram'.

assertions.description: Input lacked title frontmatter; output has it

evals.name: zinc-light-themed-render
evals.prompt: Review the mermaid diagram in evals/inputs/05-cluttered-diagram.md and run the full workflow with stakeholder_render = zinc-light. Confirm the themed PNG is produced via mmdc + init-block themeVariables and the fresh-eyes subagent dispatched.
evals.expected_output: Final mermaid source unchanged from input (Phase A clean). Themed PNG produced at the Step 6 destination using themes/zinc-light.json — slate-grey edges, light cluster tints. Fresh-eyes subagent verdict captured and surfaced.

assertions.description: A PNG was rendered at least once
Final mermaid re-renders with mmdc exit code 0
Step 6 produced a PNG with `-zinc-light.png` filename suffix at the expected destination

evals.name: existing-init-themed-render
evals.prompt: Review the mermaid diagram in evals/inputs/06-existing-init-themed.md and run the full workflow with stakeholder_render = zinc-light. The block already contains an init block with flowchart padding settings — the themed render must preserve them.
evals.expected_output: Phase A self-review walks the catalogue (likely no critical fixes needed). Phase B themed render produced via merge_theme.py — single init block in the themed source containing both the original flowchart.padding/nodeSpacing/rankSpacing AND the zinc-light themeVariables. Fresh-eyes subagent dispatched. Themed PNG saved with -zinc-light suffix.

assertions.description: If the themed temp source can be inspected: it contains exactly one %%{init: …}%% block
Themed source still contains 'padding' / '18' / 'nodeSpacing' / '55' (Phase A directives merged, not dropped)

evals.name: multi-block-disambiguation
evals.prompt: Review the mermaid diagrams in evals/inputs/07-multi-block.md.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects two blocks, lists them with index/diagram_type/title/start_line, and prompts for which one to review. Does not silently pick block 0.

assertions.description: extract_blocks.py output shows two blocks (flowchart and sequenceDiagram)
Transcript shows the skill listed both blocks and asked which to review (or accepted a block_index from the prompt)
Final state of the .md file shows exactly one mermaid block changed (the other untouched)

evals.name: broken-init-fails-cleanly
evals.prompt: Review the mermaid diagram in evals/inputs/08-broken-init.md.
evals.expected_output: Step 2 sanity render fails because the init block has a trailing comma and unbalanced braces. Skill reports the failure with the source excerpt and stops — does not enter the iteration loop, does not silently 'fix' by removing the init block without telling the user.

assertions.description: Transcript shows skill detected the render failure at pre-flight (Step 2) and stopped, surfacing the error to the user
If the skill chose to repair the init block, it did so explicitly (per the repair-init-block recipe) and reported the change in the completion message — not a silent overwrite
